desc:
Welcome to +1 Strength Lucky Fishing 💪🐟

Get stronger to fish further, get better rods, and catch as many rare fish as you can!

How to play:
💪 Train to gain +1 Casting Strength
🐟 Lure in & Catch rare Fish!
💥 Use your Strength to unlock new areas
🐟 Collect rare Fish to earn more Cash
💵 Upgrade your Fish to boost your income
🦢 Expand your pond to hold even more Fish

💤 Your Fish generate Cash while OFFLINE!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your Cash and become even stronger!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE Fish!
